segments.ja342:1.1: Asakkhiṃ vata attānaṃ, uddhātuṃ udakā thalaṃ;
segments.ja342:1.3: Na dānāhaṃ puna tuyhaṃ, vasaṃ gacchāmi vārija.
segments.ja342:2.3: Yāni pāraṃ samuddassa, varaṃ mayhaṃ udumbaro.
segments.ja342:3.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, na khippamanubujjhati;
segments.ja342:4.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, khippameva nibodhati;
